subject: Fix orch-gate deny message for the main-session / merge case — it misdirects to TaskCreate instead of explaining the real policy
description:
The orch-gate bash hook's deny message is MISLEADING for the main/dispatcher session. When a main session tries a write (e.g. `git merge` to land a worktree branch) and there are NO in-flight workers, the hook (hooks/orch-gate-bash.sh ~line 193: "try 1 trivial write/turn if workers in flight") blocks with: "orch-gate: no in-flight workers. Use native TaskCreate tool to register the task, then dispatch a subagent ... before editing." That hint is WRONG for this case — the agent doesn't need to TaskCreate; it sent the dispatcher hunting through the hook source to discover the real reason.

REAL POLICY to surface in the message: the main/dispatcher session's direct writes are only permitted while background workers are in flight; otherwise push work to a subagent/worktree. AND for the common case (merging a completed worktree attempt branch) the message should point at the RIGHT tool: `merge_attempt` (MCP, daemon-side, not bash-gated) — NOT a raw `git merge` from the main session.

FIX: differentiate the deny messages in hooks/orch-gate-bash.sh (and orch-gate.sh if symmetric):
- main session, no workers in flight, write attempt → "Dispatcher writes are gated unless a background worker is in flight. To LAND a worktree branch use merge_attempt(task_key); to do new work, dispatch a subagent (branch_task → start_task)."
- keep the subagent-no-claim message ("Call TaskCreate then start_task") only for the actual subagent-no-claim branch.
Make each branch's message state the SPECIFIC reason + the SPECIFIC remedy.

Relates to note-mqd9ezu3tu4 (gate message misleads: says 'create graph task' when native TaskCreate is right) and the existing 'Improve gate deny message' task — coordinate so messages don't conflict. Surgical text change to the hook scripts; no logic change.

summary: MERGE PENDING — orch/attempt/091a4bf1-b671-4ff9-854d-993775faa5ee-25: Fixed gate deny messages in 3 hook files. (1) hooks/orch-gate-trivial.sh main_session_deny_message(): removed misleading CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID branch that mentioned POST /agent/start; both no_workers and catch-all cases now say 'Main/dispatcher sessions must NOT claim tasks directly — use native TaskCreate tool + spawn background subagent (Agent tool, run_in_background:true) — subagent calls branch_task then start_task'. (2) hooks/orch-gate.sh line 78: subagent deny now says 'Worker subagents must call branch_task then start_task — use native TaskCreate tool (not MCP) for new tasks'. (3) hooks/orch-gate-bash.sh line 189: same subagent fix. No logic changes; text-only update. Commit b0bf426.
